attempts.summary: Deployed an Ansible playbook on node1 (connection: local) that keeps AppArmor (Ubuntu's mandatory access control framework) enforcing and installs/starts a Python-based inventory application as a systemd service (inventory-app) bound to 0.0.0.0:8181, serving JSON inventory data at /inventory. Verified reachability over the network from node2. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol on both managed nodes, one at a time, each verified via boot_id change and post-restart health checks.
